Iowa farmers have always been the first to put new technology to work when it helps them grow more efficiently and stay competitive. AI is the next frontier.

From yield mapping to precision ag, our bipartisan bill will help Iowa farmers bring new innovation from the lab to the farm. Because the future of agriculture shouldn't be decided in Washington — it should be led by Iowa farmers.

Artificial intelligence is the next frontier. From yield mapping and precision nutrient application to disease detection and water conservation, AI gives farmers better information to make better decisions in real time.

The question isn't whether AI is coming to agriculture, it's whether the next generation has the tools to use it. Our bipartisan bill makes sure the new technology being built at Iowa State reaches the farmers who'll put it to work, with the training to go with it, so the next generation inherits a stronger, smarter way to farm.

From yield mapping and precision nutrient application to disease protection and water conservation, AI gives farmers better information to make better decisions.
